title: Organizations
lead: The organization list, edits, join requests and members.

editor.name: Name
editor.slugHint: Starts with a letter; letters, digits, - and _.
editor.shortNameCreateHint: Leave empty: taken from the address.
editor.notYours: You do not administer this organization, so you cannot edit it.
editor.logoHint: An http(s) URL or a site path; the preview is on the left.
editor.logoBroken: This image does not load. Check the path before saving.
editor.adminsHint: New admins become members and join the Org Admin group. A person may administer at most 3 organizations.
editor.createNote: New organizations start closed and hidden from the list until staff list them. You are the first administrator.
editor.createNoteStaff: New organizations default to closed and hidden; untick "Hidden" to list it now. You are the first administrator.
editor.logoUploadHint: An http(s) URL or a site path, or upload a JPG, PNG, GIF or SVG (up to 5 MB); save to keep it.
editor.openHint: Anyone can join at once, without a request.
editor.unlistedHint: Only members, administrators and staff see it in the list.

errors.name: Name is 1 to 128 characters.
errors.slug: The address starts with a letter and holds only letters, digits, - and _, up to 128 characters.
errors.logo: The image must be an http(s) URL or a site path.
errors.slots: Seats is a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000.

members.title: Members
members.kickBody: They leave the organization at once; they may ask to join again.

queue.title: Join requests from every organization
queue.alreadyDecided: Another staff member already decided this request.

context.label: Organization status
context.unlistedNote: Hidden: only members, administrators and staff see it in lists.
context.recalculateHint: Recomputes PP and the member count when they drift.
context.recalculateQueued: Recalculation queued; the numbers update within minutes.

history.title: Change history
history.lead: Who created or edited the organization, or removed a member.

delete.title: Delete organization
delete.lead: Superusers only. The organization disappears from the site; its address stays reserved.
delete.keepsContent: Its problems and contests are kept and unlinked; organization-private ones stay visible only to their editors.
delete.hidesPosts: Its posts are kept, unlinked and hidden.
delete.releasesMembers: Members leave it, pending join requests are refused and its problem tags are removed.
